data.description:
Implement the post-commit hook that consumes the override token after a successful commit.

## Implementation logic
1. source plugins/dso/hooks/lib/deps.sh
2. ARTIFACTS_DIR=$(get_artifacts_dir)
3. TOKEN_FILE="$ARTIFACTS_DIR/override.token"
4. rm -f "$TOKEN_FILE"
5. exit 0

## Post-implementation
chmod +x plugins/dso/hooks/post-commit-override-cleanup.sh

## Why post-commit (not pre-commit)
Post-commit fires only after a successful commit — ensuring the token is NOT consumed by dry-run hook invocations or failed commits. This makes single-use semantics a property of git semantics, not an env-var heuristic.

## Classification
GREEN — implement to make T4 tests pass

## Files to modify
- plugins/dso/hooks/post-commit-override-cleanup.sh (CREATE)
